title: first-spin diagnostic and recovery gate
purpose: block ordering the single R2-EVT1 prototype until the reviewed H2/H6 release candidate and a recoverable six-domain diagnostic firmware package have exhausted the inexpensive pre-order evidence and are locked together as P8

procurement_boundary.factory_role: deterministically manufacture, populate and assemble the released package, including the exact production display and specified final-assembly parts
procurement_boundary.factory_powered_function_test: optional only when the final quote makes it near-free; never a release prerequisite
procurement_boundary.first_full_power_on_owner: owner after delivery using the reviewed current-limited bring-up procedure

hard_dependencies.required: reviewed six-domain production schematic and machine-readable HW/FW export
reviewed routed release candidate with fabrication, BOM, CPL, assembly and DFM outputs ready to become the immutable order release after F-PO closes
reproducible production-SDK build roots for all six domains
current R2 S3 QEMU and named target-development-board evidence without converting unavailable emulation into a false claim

the order-critical F5 diagnostic-driver slice covers every endpoint fitted by the exact H2 manifest, with present/missing identity behavior in fake-HAL and diagnostic smoke evidence on every available target-development-board path; complete product behavior is not required

evidence_gates.pass_rule: the firmware imports the exact reviewed H2/H6 candidate six-domain BSP, pin, polarity, rail, recovery and fitted-option manifests by content hash; no pre-H2 working map or historical R1 export remains authoritative

S3, C5, Hub-RP, RF-RP, Pack and Safety first-spin diagnostic images integrate the order-critical F5 diagnostic-driver slice for every endpoint fitted by the exact H2 manifest, build from locked toolchains, fit their released partitions and reproduce byte-for-byte

the exact ESP32-S3 image boots in official S3 QEMU and executes memory, retained-fault, diagnostic-menu and framebuffer test-pattern scenarios; the result makes no display, touch, USB or board-electrical claim

normal and sanitizer host runs exercise an explicit fake-HAL model for every endpoint fitted by the exact H2 manifest, including present/missing identity behavior, diagnostic UI, controls, inter-domain link faults, power and thermal faults, display orientation, touch transform and fail-closed stop paths

the order-critical diagnostic-driver slice has smoke evidence on every available target-development-board path: S3, C5, Pack and Safety boot, flash, recover and exercise their available endpoint paths on exact selected-module or selected-MCU development boards; both RP images run their available endpoint paths on the documented non-exact RP2350 surrogate, while unavailable peripherals, RP2354B package, stacked-flash and Leshy2 wiring remain explicit first-board gates
one hash-manifested owner-controlled bundle names every USB, UART and SWD entry path, target identity, image order, expected readback, retry and unbrick procedure for all six domains

a deterministic current-limited first-power-on script checks rails and faults before enabling loads, then programming/recovery, all four transports, display test patterns and touch grid, controls and LEDs, storage, audio, installed device identities and IRQs; every failed step defines a safe stop and retained diagnostic

order_authorization.pass_rule: every hard dependency and FPO1-FPO7 is reviewed against the same H2/H6 candidate hashes; P8 then locks hardware, firmware and assembly files into one immutable order release before the owner explicitly approves the exact-one quote
non_dependencies: complete product UI polish and waterfall features in F6
complete radio feature catalogue in F7
complete three-level safety UX in F8
paid factory power-on or function test

preorder_can_prove: build, partition fit and byte reproducibility
S3 CPU, memory and application control flow represented by the official emulator
portable protocol, scheduler, diagnostic UI and fault behavior through deterministic host/fake-HAL tests
target boot, flash and recovery only on each explicitly named development-board path
completeness and reproducibility of the owner bring-up package
first_physical_prototype_still_proves: PCB connectivity, footprints, soldering and final-assembly correctness
actual rails, transients, current, thermal behavior and watchdog cut-off
USB, SDIO, SPI, I2C and inter-board signal integrity on Leshy2
display flex, backlight, touch and real peripheral timing
RF matching, isolation, coexistence, range and antenna installation
audio and IR analog performance plus final mechanical fit
